messages:
alex: Heads-up — after merging model/v5.2 into staging we're seeing a 2.3x p95 token latency spike on coralv2 for short prompts (~32 tokens). Not a steady increase, looks workload-dependent.

maria: Do you have graphs/links?

alex: Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/staging/d/infra/perf?panel=kernel_selector — spike aligns with the bump at 10:12 UTC.

ryan: CI perf caught this too: perf-staging job #412 failed p95 threshold. cc @ci-bot

ci-bot: perf-staging #412: p95 latency 1.23s (threshold 0.45s) — job marked failed. Logs: /ci/jobs/412/logs

alex: Quick profiler dump I pulled from one staging pod: 
``` 
kernel_selector: selected fallback_matmul_cuda
calls: 12k
avg_kernel_time: 2.8ms (expected ~0.9ms)
kv_evictions/sec: 1800
batch_size_median: 3
seq_len_median: 34
hotpath: short-seq fast-kernel skipped due to selector score flip
```

sanjay: Hmm. kernel_selector choosing fallback kernel for short sequences is odd — selector scoring should heavily favor fast_matmul for seq<64. Any tokenization changes in v5.2?

alex: Yes — v5.2 included tokenizer-normalize which merges a couple of unicode edge cases and changed the token map. I think tokenization now emits a different length distribution for certain locale inputs, shifting the selector heuristics. Also seeing increased KV key churn which explains evictions.

maria: So tokenizer change -> token length shift -> kernel selector misrank -> fallback kernel + kvcache thrash. Tricky chain.

benchbot: quick bench run on a single coralv2 with v5.1 vs v5.2 (short prompt workload):
``` 
v5.1 p95: 0.42s
v5.2 p95: 0.98s
KV eviction rate: v5.1 200/s -> v5.2 1800/s
```

ryan: Can you bisect to a single commit? We need a candidate revert ASAP. Rollout is currently at 15% — we should pause.

alex: I ran a local bisect. Reverting commit d9f3a2 (tokenizer-normalize) returns p95 to baseline. Suspect tokenmap collision behavior causes more unique keys fed to kvcache. Also seeing kernel_selector weights recalculated due to sequence distribution statistics baked into the model metadata.

ops-bot: Rollout policy: automatic pause triggered at 20% p95 regression. Deployment held.

maria: OK let's open a revert PR for d9f3a2 and hold. Also add a quick test that compares token length histograms against a baseline for onboarding models.

sanjay: I'll draft kernel_selector mitigation: prefer fast kernel for seq_len<64 unless observed avg kernel_time for that kernel > threshold. Short-term guard to avoid misroutes when seq distribution drifts. Longer-term: decouple selector from per-model baked stats.

alex: Action items: 1) PR to revert tokenizer-normalize (P#5432) 2) add token-length histogram check in model onboarding CI 3) hotfix kernel_selector guard (draft P#5433) 4) run full kvcache warmup tests across locales and batch-size mix.

ryan: I'm linking the CI perf logs and the bisect notes in the PR. If revert fixes in staging we'll plan canary rollback to prod.

maria: Great. Reverting until we have a more surgical patch. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

alex: leaving profiler traces and a short reproducer in the PR — instructions to reproduce: 
``` 
# run short prompt workload
python tools/bench.py --model v5.2 --prompts ./samples/short_locales.txt --gpu coralv2 --profile kernel_selector
```

sanjay: I'll own the kernel_selector follow-up. Will ping when I have a patch.

ops-bot: Deployment status: staging rollback planned, rollout paused (15% -> 0%).
